description: This file contains test cases for command-related configuration resolution functions within a plugin system, utilizing vitest testing framework. It tests various scenarios for enabling/disabling native commands and skills, restart functionality, and command flags.

methods.name: resolveNativeSkillsEnabled
methods.description: Function to determine if native skills are enabled for a given provider, based on providerId and settings, considering provider-specific and global defaults.

methods.name: resolveNativeCommandsEnabled
methods.description: Function to determine if native commands are enabled for a given provider, similar to resolveNativeSkillsEnabled.

methods.name: isNativeCommandsExplicitlyDisabled
methods.description: Checks if native commands are explicitly disabled based on provider and global settings.

methods.name: isRestartEnabled
methods.description: Determines if the restart command is enabled, defaulting to true unless explicitly set to false.

methods.name: isCommandFlagEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific command flag is enabled in the provided commands object.
